title: Clinical Context Object
description: The frozen, as-of patient context care-copilot reads (doc 06 rev 3; F6 paket 5). Built only from clinical-insight's own tables: active facts (with their frozen values, comparisons and evidence pointers), the summaries and produced insights that stand at asOf, the missing-data declarations and the insights' controlled content references. Immutable once written; a later request is a new object. Every numeric or clinical claim care-copilot makes must cite a factId from this document; a content reference is never a citation (06 §7). 0.4.0 (e20): every factId an insight or summary cites resolves in the document - a cited result that is no longer current is listed under its section's citedRevisions. 0.5.0 (e22 B8): a section lists only results that hold a value at asOf (a day- or episode-keyed definition with its recent days, a rolling window with its newest result only); a result without a value is declared once in its section's missingData as a short note; evidence pointers are carried by the clinical-record families only; the flattened top-level missingData is gone; summaries are not carried (they held neither text nor values) and citedRevisions is gone - an insight carries the fact values it was produced from. 0.6.0 (e4 P10): a narrative value - a clinical text record in named sections (radiology, pathology and surgery reports, a visit's examination), cut to its definition's limits and marked truncated when cut; three clinical families (imaging, pathology, procedure). 0.7.0 (decision 61.5): a glossary - the Turkish label and reading note of every family, fact definition and insight rule the document names, once each; a number carries its amount at a reading precision (computed amounts rounded, laboratory results as reported) and no flag, a yes/no value its flag and no amount; a narrative section without a letter or digit is left out, and a narrative left without any is not listed.

asOf.description: The instant up to which data is included: facts recorded at or before it and still standing at it.

culture.description: The subject's message culture (48.12); care-copilot renders in it.

sections.description: Keyed by fact family (sleep, cardio, oxygen, recovery, activity, hydration, data, wellness, record …).

requiresHumanReview.description: True when a critical insight stands at asOf.

truncated.description: True when facts were dropped (oldest first) to respect a limit; what remains is still exact.

release.description: e15 (0.3.0): under which release the document was served. released = the public gate passed (shadow mode off and every published rule and summary clinically reviewed). preview = the machine endpoint while clinical-insight is still in shadow mode, for a preview cohort only: the content is real but its rules may not be clinically reviewed yet, so it must not be shown to a user as reviewed clinical advice.

unreviewedDefinitions.description: The rules this document's insights come from whose version is still waiting for clinical review (0.5.0: the document carries no summaries); always empty when released.

glossary.description: 0.7.0 (decision 61.5): what the codes mean, in the document's culture - one entry per family (section), fact definition (the canonical id of a definition, without its version) and insight rule the document names. An id clinical-insight has no text for is left out.

facts.description: e22 B8 (0.5.0): the results that hold a value at asOf. A day- or episode-keyed device definition keeps its recent days; a rolling or calendar window only its newest result (it covers the earlier keys); a clinical record only its current result.

missingData.description: e22 B8 (0.5.0): one short note per definition whose newest key holds no value at asOf (not computable, or its validity ended). An earlier day without a value is not declared; a clinical record without a current result is not declared at all.

validUntil.description: P9 (additive in 0.2.0): the instant the content stops being valid (the definition's validity period after the newest source record); null = no period. A listed fact is always valid at asOf - one whose validity ended is declared under its section's missingData with reason expired instead.

evidence.description: e22 B8 (0.5.0): clinical-record families only (medication, diagnosis, visit, lab, glucose; 0.6.0: imaging, pathology, procedure), where occurredAt is the record's own date. A device result carries none: its window is occurredFrom/occurredTo.

scalarValue.description: 0.7.0: a number - computed amounts rounded to a reading precision (an hour to one decimal, anything else to two), laboratory and glucose results as the laboratory reported them.

booleanValue.description: 0.7.0: a yes/no value (no shipped definition yields one today).

narrativeValue.description: 0.6.0 (e4 P10): what a clinician wrote, as written (personal identifiers masked by the producer), in named sections; a record of the past, not a claim about today. An empty source section is left out.

truncated.description: True when a section was cut to the definition's limit (ended with an ellipsis) or dropped because the item's limit was spent.

facts.description: e22 B8 (0.5.0): the facts the insight was produced from, with the values it read (a snapshot). The same factId may also be listed in its section's facts; when the fact has been re-evaluated since, the current value is there under the same definition and evaluationKey.

code.description: The fact definition that could not be evaluated.

reason.description: Absent = data-required (0.5.0: the common reason is not written). expired (P9, additive in 0.2.0): the result's validity period ended; missing names the period (expired:<N>d) when the engine wrote it so, else expired.

contentReference.description: A resolved, controlled content pointer of a standing insight (13): permanent provider identity only, never a URL or binary; never a citation.
